programs.title: Surveillance Oz: Dashcam
programs.desc: Every day thousands of dashcam cameras in cars are monitoring what goes on across the roads of Australia. Tonight, a Queensland flower grower is hit by an out of control truck in torrential rain.

programs.title: Outback Hunters
programs.desc: The dry season is half over and the hunters of Australia s Northern Territory are anxious to bring in as many crocs as possible before the rain returns and the waterways double in size.

programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.desc: Fishing expert Mark Berg visits some of the best fishing destinations around. Chasing a wide variety of fish, Mark is always hoping to capture a new species or develop a new technique.

programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: Fishy Business
programs.desc: Spring fires up as Adam targets shallow snapper with soft baits, showing key rigging and retrieves, while Darren dives below to reveal snapper behaviour up close.

programs.title: Classic Restos: USA Edition
programs.desc: Fletch returns to the US and the home of Automotive Manufacturing, Detroit. The Chrysler Corporations Turbine Concept Car from the 1960's is revealed. Only 55 of these two-door coupes were produced.

programs.title: Classic Restos: USA Edition
programs.desc: This week Fletch heads to custom body fabricators 'Mob Steel' where they have become one of the top custom car builders in the US. Transforming Detroit vintage steel into modern - day machines.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: At Detroit's abandoned Packard plant, Mike gets a tour of an American landmark before it disappears. And in Buffalo, Retro Ron's collection features the Holy Grail of vintage bikes.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Shoot the breeze with the Pawn Stars when a tree with an 1800s revolver inside it takes root in the shop. Will Rick think money grows on this tree or will he be barking up the wrong one?

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Open wide with the Pawn Stars when an early 1900s Peerless Harvard dental chair rolls into the shop. Can Corey drill into the negotiation or will it be like pulling teeth?

programs.title: The 4WD Adventure Show
programs.desc: Outback travel is about more than the journey, it’s about remembering those who travelled the land before us and learning from their experiences.

programs.title: Life Off Road
programs.desc: Life Off Road celebrates all aspects of four-wheel driving and off-roading.
